description: Run the applicable publication checks after publish_cap, before submit_cap. Managed qumge wrapper operations use authenticated isolated fixture hooks and validate the complete fixture result. Native managed API/MCP operations check HTTP OPTIONS or MCP tools/list for connection/schema evidence without invoking generation. The verification array distinguishes connection, fixture and real_delivery scopes; real delivery is not tested. Legacy integrations may call one free and one billable route, or each published MCP tool, directly with probe inputs; Qumge does not charge for these probes, but the developer may incur provider costs. Signed wrapper/legacy APIs also test /qumge/ping with valid, forged and stale signatures; legacy usage-reporting routes must report probe usage. Missing billed-operation docs block publishing. Needs the developer's Qumge key. (Older clients may still call this tool as test_app.)

price_version.description: Explicit candidate version; isolated checks do not activate it or overwrite current publication evidence.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: test_cap
